title: SMPServerStart
description: SMPStart turns your SMP start into a cinematic event with a 10-second
body:
🌌 SMPStart

SMPStart turns the start of your SMP into a full server event instead of just players spawning in.

When you run /smpstart, the server goes through a short cinematic sequence with a countdown, particles, world border changes, and a shared “SMP HAS STARTED” moment for everyone online.

⸻

⚙ What it does

SMPStart is a lightweight but cinematic plugin for Paper servers that handles SMP openings in a more interesting way than just teleporting players into a world.

It includes:

* ⏱ 10-second start countdown with titles
* ✨ Particle effects that scale up during the countdown
* 🌍 World border animation (starts small, then expands at launch)
* 🚀 Player launch into the sky at start
* 🛡 Optional PvP grace period after launch
* 📊 Bossbar showing grace time remaining
* 🎛 GUI panel for controlling everything in-game

⸻

🎨 Themes

You can change the whole atmosphere of the event using built-in themes:

* 🌌 Cosmic
* ⛈ Storm
* 🔥 Inferno
* 🌿 Nature
* 🌑 Void
* ❄ Frost

Each theme changes particles, sounds, and overall feel of the event.

⸻

🌀 Particle system

Instead of random particles, SMPStart uses structured effects like:

* spirals
* orbit rings
* vortex shapes
* helix-style effects
* expanding shockwaves

These get more intense as the countdown reaches zero.

⸻

🌍 World border

Before the SMP starts, the world border is kept tight for effect.
When the event hits 0, it expands to full size in a cinematic way.

⸻

🛡 Grace period

After the launch:

* ⚔ PvP can be disabled automatically (configurable)
* 📊 A bossbar shows remaining grace time
* 🔓 After it ends, PvP is enabled again

⸻

🎛 GUI

You can open a control panel with:

/smpstart panel

From there you can:

* start/stop the event
* change theme
* toggle PvP
* adjust timings
* configure rewards

⸻

📜 Commands

* /smpstart — start the event
* /smpstart stop — cancel it
* /smpstart theme <name> — change theme
* /smpstart panel — open GUI
* /smpstart reload — reload config
* /smpspawnset — set center point

Permission: smpstart.admin (default: op)

⸻

⚙ Setup

1. Put the jar into /plugins
2. Restart the server
3. Stand at spawn and run /smpspawnset
4. Pick a theme
5. Run /smpstart when ready

⸻

🧠 Requirements

* Paper 1.21.1+
